terra.problem: “It's what gets the word out” turns the stated purpose of the blessing into a mechanism the psalm does not specify.
The psalm asks God to bless “us” so His ways and salvation will be known; it does not say the blessing itself is aimed at the whole earth.
The claim that priests and praise appear together often in the Bible needs a reference outside this passage.
The psalm calls on the nations to sing; it does not say they are already singing.
“One people” identifies the group asking for blessing more specifically than the psalm's “us” does.
